changeinfo.changes:
Changes: Button hints with improved readability Corrected over 40 collision issues/problems Other minor improvements Camera hints were improved
Bug fixes: - Several collision problems throughout the game - Camera transitions and positions - Camera hints works better overall - In some conditions the player couldn't enter the room where the tree is planted - Text corrections - Pause in the snow chapter - Player could get stuck on the branch in the windy chapter - Player would die too early if you fell from an edge (underwater) - In some conditions the player couldn't jump and/or attack anymore - Several problems when interacting with the statues in the first boss fight
